gap: No result ChatGPT got states that all four carded kits stop solar-charging below 0 °C / 32 °F (eufy SoloCam S340 charges only between 0 °C and 40 °C, the Tapo C660 KIT's A201 panel between 0 °C and 45 °C, and Reolink's Solar Panel, Solar Panel 2 and Solar Panel 3 between 0 °C and 45 °C), or that Reolink's Solar Panel 2S has its own 5,900 mAh battery that keeps powering the camera down to -20 °C.
standout_why: I compared against both cited pages, rottenwifi.com/best-solar-powered-home-security-cameras-for-2026 and reolink.com/blog/solar-powered-security-cameras-buying-guide. Neither gives a charging-temperature range for any camera it reviews. Rottenwifi lists the Argus 4 Pro's operating range (-10 to 55 °C), which is not its charging range. Its only charging limit sits in an Amazon listing for the Tapo C402, which is not a ChatGPT pick ('Solar charging requires temperatures above 32°F'). Reolink's blog only says cold 'reduces the effective runtime' and that winter sun is lower. It never says charging stops, and it never mentions the Solar Panel 2S. SafeWise (rank 2, not cited) has the general point in one line: 'the battery probably won't charge below 32º F.' It names no product figures and no workaround, so I rated this 2 rather than 3. I could not read pvrblog (rank 1): the fetch failed on its SSL certificate.
decides: The answer frames sunlight as the only limit on solar power. For a shopper in a place with freezing winters, every kit ChatGPT carded stops charging on sub-zero days, however sunny. The camera then runs only on its own battery until it warms up. That favors the larger internal battery (Tapo C660 at 10,000 mAh; Argus Eco Ultra at 21.6 Wh). It also favors pairing a Reolink camera with the Solar Panel 2S, which Reolink says recharges its own battery from -10 °C and powers the camera from -20 °C. The Argus 4 Pro is one of the cameras Reolink names as compatible with it. The eufy S340, picked as 'best overall', has the narrowest charging range of the four (0–40 °C) and has no buffered-panel option I could source. For shoppers in mild climates, the pick doesn't change.

findings.value: 5,900 mAh / 42.48 Wh built-in battery; 6 W panel (6 V, 0.96 A); between 0 °C and -20 °C its battery 'will directly power the camera instead of charging it'; it recharges itself from -10 °C
